item.description:
Swift 6 strict-concurrency migration. No user-visible feature changes; the binary behavior is identical to v0.3.1. Pits now compiles under Swift 6 with SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete, so any future code that crosses an actor boundary unsafely is a compile error rather than a runtime data race.

  • Production code is concurrency-clean. Eight Swift 6 diagnostics resolved across Pricing, PitsApp, ConversationRowView, ConversationStore, LogWatcher, and SnapshotCache. The two load-bearing changes are LogWatcher and SnapshotCache adopting @unchecked Sendable — both already serialize all mutable state through their internal DispatchQueues; the unchecked conformance captures the existing-and-correct invariant the compiler can’t see. Audit-locked false positives #1 and #6 from v0.3.0 are re-evaluated and remain locked against actor conversion.
  • Test target is concurrency-clean. 22 diagnostics resolved across ConversationListSnapshotTests (now @MainActor), ConversationStoreCacheTests (switched to setUp/tearDown async variants), and RemotePricingTests (StubURLProtocol.handler is nonisolated(unsafe)).
  • Under the hood: SWIFT_VERSION 5.9 → 6.0; 259 tests on macos-26.
